subject: Rats example compilation fails with Stan 2.1.0, works with 2.0.1

messages.author: d4d87473a37ad6c0
messages.subject: Rats example compilation fails with Stan 2.1.0, works with 2.0.1
parts:
The rats example is failing with the following messages with CmdStan 2.1.0 running on OSX 10.7.5, 

mux:stan-2.1.0 brian$ g++ --version
i686-apple-darwin11-llvm-g++-4.2 (GCC) 4.2.1 (Based on Apple Inc. build 5658) (LLVM build 2335.15.00)
mux:stan-2.1.0 brian$ make --version
GNU Make 3.81

mux:stan-2.1.0 brian$ make src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats

--- Translating Stan model to C++ code ---
bin/stanc src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.stan --o=src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp
Model name=rats_model
Input file=src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.stan
Output file=src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp
g++ -I src -isystem lib/eigen_3.2.0 -isystem lib/boost_1.54.0 -Wall -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -Wno-unused-function -ftemplate-depth-256   -c -O3 -o src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.o src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp: In member function ‘T rats_model_namespace::rats_model::log_prob(Eigen::Matrix<T_cut, -0x00000000000000001, 1, 0, -0x00000000000000001, 1>&, std::ostream*) const’:
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp:343: error: ‘rats_model_namespace::rats_model::T’ cannot appear in a constant-expression
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp:343: error: template argument 1 is invalid
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp:343: error: template argument 2 is invalid
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp:343: error: invalid type in declaration before ‘;’ token
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp:344: error: request for member ‘reserve’ in ‘vec_params_r’, which is of non-class type ‘int’
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp:346: error: request for member ‘push_back’ in ‘vec_params_r’, which is of non-class type ‘int’
src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp:348: error: ‘rats_model_namespace::rats_model::T’ cannot appear in a constant-expression
src/stan/math/constants.hpp: At global scope:
src/stan/math/constants.hpp:63: warning: ‘stan::math::NEGATIVE_EPSILON’ defined but not used
make: *** [src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.o] Error 1

Seems to work fine with CmdStan 2.0.1:

mux:stan-2.0.1 brian$ make src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats

--- Translating Stan model to C++ code ---
bin/stanc src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.stan --o=src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp
Model name=rats_model
Input file=src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.stan
Output file=src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp
g++ -I src -isystem lib/eigen_3.2.0 -isystem lib/boost_1.54.0 -Wall -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -Wno-unused-function -ftemplate-depth-256   -c -O3 -o src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.o src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.cpp

--- Linking C++ model ---
g++ -I src -isystem lib/eigen_3.2.0 -isystem lib/boost_1.54.0 -Wall -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -Wno-unused-function -ftemplate-depth-256    -O3 -o src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats src/models/bugs_examples/vol1/rats/rats.o -Lbin -lstan

Any ideas?
-b

messages.author: d4fb714af6c90658
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Rats example compilation fails with Stan 2.1.0, works with 2.0.1
parts:
Il 13/01/2014 15:38, Brian Lau ha scritto:
> The rats example is failing with the following messages with CmdStan
> 2.1.0 running on OSX 10.7.5,

It looks like 'T' has become a reserved name, see:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/stan-users/yUfwl1RJA7g

However, that'd be a real nuisance but indeed I can compile rats.stan
and then sample:

> library(rstan)
[...]
rstan (Version 2.1.0, packaged: 2013-12-27 18:21:10 UTC, GitRev:
548aa7bbbb89)
> sm <- stan_model("rats.stan")

TRANSLATING MODEL 'rats' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL 'rats' NOW.

> source("rats.data.R")
> sf <- sampling(sm, data=c("N", "T", "x", "xbar", "y"))
> print(sf)

I'm using g++ 4.8.1 and R 3.0.2 on Linux (Ubuntu 12.04).

Sergio
